background.rule: Pure black OR dark desaturated grey — ALWAYS

text_overlay.content_rule: The most extreme single fact from the video — NOT a repeat of the title
text_overlay.font: Heavy condensed bold sans-serif (Impact or equivalent)
text_overlay.placement: Top-left, bottom-left, or center — never competes with subject
styles: White text in red filled rectangle (most common, ~60%)
White bold text with black outline (archival/CCTV thumbnails)
Yellow bold text with black outline (positive reveals: GENIUS)

color_treatment.subject_treatment: Red color grade overlay on faces, OR red object coloring for CGI builds, OR red banner label
color_treatment.rule: Every thumbnail has exactly one strong color — almost always red

arrow_callout.style: Bold red arrow or speech bubble callout pointing to key subject
arrow_callout.purpose: Creates a 'reveal' interaction — viewer has to look where the arrow points
examples: Arrow + IT'S THEM pointing to hackers
KKK/FBI speech bubble labels on each person

person_face_closeup.description: Real historical photo, often red color-graded, direct eye contact at viewer
person_face_closeup.treatment: Desaturated + red tint, often slight vignette

cgi_3d_object.description: Custom 3D rendered model of the subject — NOT stock photos
cgi_3d_object.style: Photorealistic but clearly synthetic, red color treatment

composite_scene.description: Multiple cutout figures composited on dark background to show the twist
examples: FBI agent surrounded by 4 KKK figures
composite_scene.rule: Scene visually SHOWS the twist without needing a caption to explain

archival_footage.description: Real CCTV/surveillance-style grainy footage treated as a leak
examples: Russian hackers walking through airport corridor
archival_footage.treatment: Heavy grain, scanlines, B&W or desaturated, 'leaked footage' feel

composition.rule: NEVER more than 2 elements competing for attention
composition.subject_position: Slightly left of center OR centered, leaving space for text
composition.perspective: Low angle or straight-on — subjects feel powerful/threatening
composition.eye_contact: Direct at viewer when faces present — creates personal threat feeling

never_use: Fern's own face or any presenter face
Text that repeats the video title

generation_prompt_template: Dark almost-black background. [SUBJECT: brief description]. Red color treatment. [TEXT: 1-3 words in bold white on red rectangle, top-left]. Cinematic, editorial style. No faces of presenters.
